title: Market-wide manager preload and reverse lookup
changes: Preload all filers in the existing September 2023-onward holdings window from official bulk ZIPs, then checkpoint individual newer filings. Keep the 1994-onward identity directory separate.
Store compact reconciled accession-level manager buckets, not duplicate security histories; publish indexed firm-manager-quarter generations outside report requests.
Add protected manager-to-reporting-firms lookup, gross reported attribution totals, same-firm comparable changes, histories and explicit partial coverage.
Preserve SEC source hashes, rejected filings, shared-attribution and missing-data warnings; totals across reporters may overlap and are not verified client assets or flows.
Use additive isolated FIG tables and retain raw snapshots, source revisions, access restrictions, trading systems and existing page behavior.

title: SEC-wide filer directory and selected-firm history loading
changes: Replace one-firm whitelist with official SEC quarterly master-index identity directory, 1994 onward.
Keep directory discovery separate from reconciled holdings; include notices and historical filers without invented balances.
Use a durable, deduplicated selected-filer queue and existing cross-process import lock; daily checks refresh the directory and previously requested firms.
Retain source hashes, explicit incomplete/stale coverage, importer safeguards, all original snapshots and independent version records.

title: Outside-manager assets, history and paired changes
reason: Make manager-level research the default instead of individual securities.
changes: Aggregate stored reconciled filing rows through accession-local other-manager sequence mappings.
Retain stable-ID or conservative exact-name identity across quarters; never join managers by sequence number.
Show reported assets, quarter/year changes, all available periods and ranked opposite-change pairs.
Reconcile single-linked, jointly linked, unassigned, unresolved and options values without double counting.
Distinguish absent managers from zero, missing quarters from comparable quarters, and additive amendments from restatements.
Keep source accessions, hashes, method version and limitations in the report.
unchanged: No production schema changes or client/trading changes
limitations: 13F-covered reported holdings only; not total AUM, a complete platform census or verified transfers.
Other included managers can include affiliates; external relationship is not independently verified.

title: Verified SEC importer and visible import lifecycle
reason: Repair unverified/manual imports and make source processing auditable.
changes: Use the same declared SEC contact setting for manual and scheduled imports.
Support dated individual XML filings and bounded streaming reads of official ZIP/TSV archives.
Reconcile filing identity, reporting period, source row count and source total before storing or displaying a filing.
Normalize dollars using filing date; remove the erroneous second multiplication by 1000 in analysis.
Retain raw source values, source URLs/hashes, other-manager identifiers, options and share types.
Store verified revisions separately; retain legacy records without displaying them as verified.
Record import IDs, stage, heartbeat, progress, failures, interrupted jobs, version and deployment commit.
Verify committed filings through an independent database connection and retain append-only import/release events.
Handle restatement and new-holdings amendments separately; preserve source accessions for each period.
limitations: Daily checks do not create daily holdings; 13F remains periodic public disclosure.
Coverage remains the configured Oppenheimer Asset Management reporting entity, not the entire brokerage platform.
Change records support compliance review; no claim of regulatory certification or immutable WORM retention.

title: Initial FIG research prototype
reason: Retrospective baseline record for commit cd6135c81adb423ab1950f672066fd6a9a6d5fcd.
changes: Initial XML loader, isolated FIG database, Toolkit gateway, filing history and exploratory trends.
limitations: No reconciled live import had been established at baseline.
Initial analysis had a dollar scaling defect; manual import service lacked SEC_USER_AGENT.
